text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, at the training track...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Hmm, where else can I improve?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ah, greetings. May I have some of your
time?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
To tell the truth, I've been puzzling over
how to
improve my times, but I have
been unable to
come up with any ideas.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
If you were to offer your own racer
advice, what
would you say?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Stamina and guts, you say? I feel as though I have been focusing on them...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
But I suppose you are quite right. No
amount of
training can ever be enough.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much for your advice. I
shall start
training at once!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
My start, you say? You may have a
point. I don't
think I have put much
focus on it before.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
But if I mean to reach greater heights, it
may be
necessary to anticipate how
races will pan out
from the very start.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much for your advice. I
shall
incorporate this into my training at
once!
